anchorCorrection_a2.mechanism: decouple the mount anchor offset from (restLength - staticSag): static floor height above road = radius + RestLength + preload - StaticSag - (wheelCentreY + anchorOffset) + floorY = radius + preload - anchorOffset - (wheelCentreY - floorY); at the tied default anchorOffset=+0.11 the guard datum sits at -0.2004+preload (impossible); lowering the anchor raises the whole body relative to the road without touching the spring state

anchorCorrection_a2.note: needs the ride gate to compute the anchor-aware stance (stance0 = sourceClearance + (restMinusSagDefault - anchorOffset)); without it the gate still demands 0.235 and blocks

anchorCorrection_a2.wheelEnvelopeCheck: ray reach = radius+restLength+preload+0.15 = 0.705m from a lower anchor - comfortably reaches the road at the static and loaded states; no droop limiter invented
